name: io.github.tonyyang0504/gooten-mcp
description: Gooten (ecommerce suppliers): me, list_products, create_order, get_order, track. Every tool maps to

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_GOOTEN_RECIPE_ID
environmentVariables.description: Gooten RecipeID (public key, Admin Panel > Settings > API), sent as the `recipeid` query parameter on every call.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_GOOTEN_PARTNER_BILLING_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Gooten PartnerBillingKey (private key from the same API settings page), sent inside create_order's Payment object so Gooten bills your account; required only for create_order.
